description: This file implements a scheduler component for user equipment (UE) resource allocation in a cellular network, including functions for calculating MCS and TBS, allocating downlink and uplink grants, setting parameters for PDSCH and PUSCH, and post-processing results. It manages resource grids, HARQ processes, and control signaling for scheduling UEs.

classes.name: ue_cell_grid_allocator
classes.description: Main class responsible for resource allocation and scheduling of UEs in a cellular network, managing grants, parameters, and post-processing.

classes.name: ue_cell_grid_allocator::dl_newtx_grant_builder
classes.description: Helper class for setting downlink PDSCH parameters in a grant.

classes.name: ue_cell_grid_allocator::ul_newtx_grant_builder
classes.description: Helper class for setting uplink PUSCH parameters in a grant.

methods.name: calculate_dl_mcs_tbs
methods.description: Calculates the downlink MCS and TBS based on resource allocation, CSI-RS overhead, and carrier configuration.

methods.name: alloc_dl_pdcch
methods.description: Allocates a downlink PDCCH for a UE in a given search space.

methods.name: alloc_uci
methods.description: Allocates UCI (HARQ ACK, CSI, SR) for a UE.

methods.name: allocate_dl_grant
methods.description: Sets up a downlink grant for a new transmission request.

methods.name: setup_dl_grant_builder
methods.description: Creates and initializes a downlink grant with parameters for PDSCH transmission.

methods.name: allocate_ul_grant
methods.description: Sets up an uplink grant for a new transmission request.

methods.name: setup_ul_grant_builder
methods.description: Creates and initializes an uplink grant with parameters for PUSCH transmission.

methods.name: set_pdsch_params
methods.description: Configures PDSCH parameters in a grant, including resource blocks, MCS, and HARQ info.

methods.name: set_pusch_params
methods.description: Configures PUSCH parameters in a grant, including resource blocks, MCS, and HARQ info.

methods.name: post_process_results
methods.description: Cleans up and finalizes resource allocation results after scheduling.

methods.name: post_process_pucch_pw_ctrl_results
methods.description: Updates PUCCH power control states based on scheduled grants.
